blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style wooden trapdoor entrance consisting of a square dark-brown timber frame sitting flat on the floor, an open green-painted wooden plank hatch cover propped vertically upright on metal strap hinges, and the top section of a light-brown wooden ladder emerging from the dark recessed opening.
blind.from_above: A square dark-wood frame enclosing a dark square opening, with the top two rungs and uprights of a light-brown wooden ladder visible inside, and a rectangular green plank lid extended along the upper edge attached by two dark metal hinges.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: recessed interior opening beneath the ladder is flat black to simulate a dark hole/drop
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 ft wide by 3.5 ft deep; the upright open lid reaches roughly 2.5 to 3 ft tall, about waist height (less than half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure).
